asset_shared_with_dex.note: Both vaults hold the same FAsset the M5/M6 DEX config already carries.

firelight.withdraw_model: delayed request: withdraw()/redeem() create a request for currentPeriod, NO immediate transfer; claimWithdraw(period) after the period ends

upshift.withdraw_model: two routes: instantRedeem(shares,receiver,holder) burns LP for immediate assets at instantRedemptionFee; OR requestRedeem -> lagDuration -> claim(year,month,day,receiver) at (lower) withdrawalFee

load_bearing_finding: Deposit is standard ERC-4626 (immediate). Withdrawal is NON-standard and vault-specific: Firelight redeem/withdraw create a period-bound REQUEST (assets only via claimWithdraw); Upshift offers an instant route (higher fee) vs a lag+calendar-epoch request/claim route (lower fee). A mock copying 'standard ERC-4626 redeem' would render a withdrawal request as assets-received — the submitted-as-succeeded failure the hard rules forbid. The two vaults have materially different ABIs; the shared abstraction is the operation lifecycle, NOT one ABI (the M6 'venue-specific' lesson).
